reason: Going from $600 a year to nearly $2,400 is a big jump for me, especially since I can still keep my cousin doing my taxes at the end of the year, so Document A's radical honesty—even admitting the recent price hike from $149—makes me trust this person right away. Document B isn't bad, but it leaves out the price increase and adds extra claims about Sunday nights and shoeboxes that weren't in the facts.
